findings.text: non-blocking: the diff reflows the `_placement_of_running_serve(site, targets[0] if targets else None)` call in `key_command` onto one line purely for formatting, in a function that has nothing to do with the snapshot schedule; it is cargo from a whole-file format pass and is the one hunk in the diff that the goal does not imply, so a reader cannot tell from the diff alone whether this function mattered to the node.

non-blocking: an existing exact-equality assertion was relaxed rather than kept, `_digest(restored) == _digest(continuous)` becoming `_logical_rows(restored) == _logical_rows(continuous)` with the source table's `mtime_ns` column dropped from the comparison; that column is exactly what drives change detection at imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_index.py:981, and the divergence that motivated the relaxation survives only as a retry_failures line in the run manifest, so nothing in the repository records what the restored index stores differently. The behavioural consequence is still covered because the same test asserts rows_inserted == 1 then == 1 then == 0, which is why this does not hold the node.

justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only over the base pair lists exactly the four granted paths and no figure directory, but imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2064 carries a formatting-only reflow of an unrelated call in key_command that the goal does not imply.
